coverage_notes: Covers envelope parsing (valid, incomplete, wrong version)
Covers envelope validation (version, broadcast, correlation, payload size)
Covers receipt action parsing (valid wake, invalid format)
Covers root selection (missing, duplicate, wrong type, missing policy, participant mismatch)
Covers structural integrity (child policy forbidden, root close=true, policy bounds)
Does NOT yet cover: multi-turn conversations with validated attempts, closed/active/exhausted/deadman status, fleet mismatch detection, alternation checking, or the full receipt lifecycle walk
future_expansion: Active and closed status via validated reply attempts
Deadman status (reservation without completion within deadline)
